Card Q&A.q: If [Marcus Damon] is treated as a Digimon by this card's effect and then its DP is reduced to 0 by an effect, is it deleted?

Effect: [Start of Your Main Phase][When Digivolving] Until the end of your opponent's turn, 1 of your [Marcus Damon]s is also treated as a 3000 DP Digimon, can't digivolve, and gains ＜Blocker＞.
[All Turns][Once Per Turn] When any of your red or yellow Tamers suspend, 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -6000 DP for the turn.
